limitations: PID/OT collisions, duplicated Pokemon and legitimate edits must be reviewed; no automatic donor replacement.
Invalid-checksum decoded fields are clues, not authenticated original values.
Sector-valid/mon-invalid means the invalid bytes were committed with valid outer checksums; it does not identify the producer or root cause.
Party unused entries are reported separately and are not treated as live party Pokemon.
No global chronology inferred from save names, mtime, or counters from different save lineages.
Static checksum audit does not reproduce DELTA runtime corruption; no ROM compatibility claim without matching source offsets.
